Hi Sara / Carlos —

Thanks again for the time earlier — quick recap and next steps so we can lock the 30-minute intro/demo. High-level takeaways from our discovery: 
- You need predictable latency for short prompt pipelines and a way to run evals against sample prompts you shared.
- Primary success criteria: 99th percentile latency under 300ms for the web product flow, and ability to run daily embedding batches at < $0.05/1k.
- Required attendees for next session: Product owner (to confirm UX & acceptance), Tech owner (to validate infra/latency), and one stakeholder for procurement if we talk pricing.

Can you confirm who will join from your side? To make scheduling easy, here are three 30-minute windows (all in PDT):
1) Tue Jul 25, 2028 — 10:00–10:30 AM PDT (ideal for product + procurement)
2) Wed Jul 26, 2028 — 2:00–2:30 PM PDT (best for technical deep-dive; we can keep 10–15m for latency/throughput)
3) Thu Jul 27, 2028 — 11:00–11:30 AM PDT (flex window if exec needs to join)

If you prefer other times, tell me two alternatives and I'l re-propose. Attendees on our side: myself (account lead) and a solutions engineer for the technical portion — I'll loop Monica once we have a slot.

Attached: post-discovery recap (one-pager) and a proposed 30m agenda.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
